name: deck-craft
description: PowerPoint decks two ways, template-first: consulting-grade analyst decks (pyramid storyline, action titles, one message per slide, native editable charts, sources) and bold keynote or launch decks (sparkline arc, few words, huge type, one number per slide, reveals, speaker notes), always inside the slide master when one exists. Captures a master or brand book into a design guide, builds with python-pptx (deckkit) or in the PowerPoint add-in, and checks and renders the result. Adds the deck-craft, deck-storyline, deck-keynote, deck-exhibits, deck-design-guide and deck-review skills.
